what: Code unification after the study (protocol deviation D-11): the paired inference (nonzero axis, TOST, Holm) and the per-unit projections (alignment, scale ratio, cosine, relative RMS) of the study scripts now call the tool (kernel_analyzer.reference_eval.analysis.unit_axes / holm_adjusted, observation.output_unit). Each affected result was recomputed with the unified code into .cache/round2/unify_check and compared field by field with the version committed in 91f5819.

paired_summaries.values: identical except four TOST one-sided bounds (tost_ci90) that differ by 1-2 ulps (multiplication order)
paired_summaries.new_fields: the tool's skewness diagnostic (unit_skewness, t_approximation) and, where |skewness| >= 1, the bootstrap-t companion: pure_bf16 - fp32_master skewness 1.69, companion [-0.115, -0.108], verdict unchanged
paired_summaries.action: the three files replaced by the recomputed versions (previous versions at 91f5819)

question1_baselines.result: bitwise identical to the committed files except the run time
question1_baselines.action: committed files kept; the helper uses the same expressions, so the other strata are reproduced the same way

result.eager_highest: losses identical 8/8, other per-unit values within 1.7e-13 relative (summation order)
result.eager_high: losses identical 8/8, other per-unit values within 1.5e-13 relative
result.compiled_high: run-to-run variation of the max-autotune compile: losses differ up to 2.6e-4; summary loss -5.48e-4 vs -5.56e-4, logits alignment -4.17e-4 vs -4.18e-4, Adam update cosine (MLP) 0.9969 vs 0.9970
result.compiled_highest: run-to-run variation at fp32-noise level (loss differences up to 1.2e-6)

C2_downstream.conclusions: unchanged (single-layer shrink reaches the logits; Adam one-step direction cosine about 0.997; loss difference indistinguishable from zero)
C2_downstream.action: committed file kept as produced at 91f5819; the compiled variants are not bitwise reproducible between runs (whether autotuning chose the same kernels was not checked)

tests: python -m pytest -q 2_tool/tests: 1617 passed (two new tests for unit_axes and output_unit)
